const uid=Number(msg.senderId||0)||Number(msg.chatId||0);
const db=Object.assign({},msg);
db.query=`WITH u AS (
 INSERT INTO chat_users (telegram_user_id, first_name, last_name, username, display_name, updated_at)
 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,NOW())
 ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id) DO UPDATE SET
  first_name=EXCLUDED.first_name,last_name=EXCLUDED.last_name,username=EXCLUDED.username,
  display_name=EXCLUDED.display_name,updated_at=NOW()
 RETURNING telegram_user_id
), m AS (
 INSERT INTO chat_messages
 (chat_id,message_id,sender_id,sender_name,username,message_date,message_type,text,reply_to_message_id,raw_json,created_at)
 VALUES ($6,$7,$1,$5,$4,$8,$9,$10,$11,$12::jsonb,NOW())
 ON CONFLICT (chat_id,message_id) DO UPDATE SET text=EXCLUDED.text,raw_json=EXCLUDED.raw_json
 RETURNING id
) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u) AS users,(SELECT count(*) FROM m) AS messages`;
db.params=[
 uid,
 msg.originalMessage?.from?.first_name||null,
 msg.originalMessage?.from?.last_name||null,
 msg.username,
 msg.senderName,
 msg.chatId,
 msg.messageId,
 msg.messageDate,
 msg.messageType,
 msg.text||null,
 msg.replyToMessageId||null,
 JSON.stringify(msg.originalMessage||{})
];
return [msg,db];

name: Route Command / Chat
Automatic Memory Batch Gate
Find Pending Memory Chats
Prepare Memory Batch Query
func:
const n=Math.max(10,Number(env.get('AI_MEMORY_BATCH_MESSAGES')||30));
msg.query=`
SELECT cm.chat_id, cm.message_id, cm.sender_id, cm.sender_name, cm.username,
       cm.message_date, cm.text, cm.reply_to_message_id
FROM chat_messages cm
WHERE cm.chat_id=$1
  AND cm.message_id > COALESCE(
    (SELECT last_processed_message_id FROM ai_memory_state WHERE chat_id=$1),0)
  AND cm.text IS NOT NULL
  AND length(trim(cm.text)) > 0
ORDER BY cm.message_id ASC
LIMIT $2;`;
msg.params=[msg.chatId,n];
return msg;

name: Build Memory Extraction Context
Prepare AI Memory Request
Parse Memory JSON
Prepare Memory Upsert
func:
const memories=(msg.extractedMemories||[]).map(m=>({
 chat_id:Number(msg.chatId),
 memory_type:String(m.memory_type||'important').slice(0,40),
 title:String(m.title||'').trim().slice(0,250),
 content:String(m.content||'').trim(),
 importance:Math.min(5,Math.max(1,Number(m.importance)||3)),
 source_message_id:Number(m.source_message_id||msg.memoryLastMessageId||0)||null,
 sender_id:Number(m.sender_id||0)||null,
 sender_name:String(m.sender_name||'').trim().slice(0,250)||null
})).filter(m=>m.title&&m.content);
msg.validMemories=memories;
msg.query=`
INSERT INTO ai_memories
(chat_id,memory_type,title,content,importance,source_message_id,sender_id,sender_name,created_at,updated_at)
SELECT x.chat_id,x.memory_type,x.title,x.content,x.importance,x.source_message_id,x.sender_id,x.sender_name,NOW(),NOW()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
 chat_id bigint,memory_type text,title text,content text,importance integer,
 source_message_id bigint,sender_id bigint,sender_name text
)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id,memory_type,title)
DO UPDATE SET
 content=EXCLUDED.content,
 importance=GREATEST(ai_memories.importance,EXCLUDED.importance),
 source_message_id=EXCLUDED.source_message_id,
 sender_id=EXCLUDED.sender_id,
 sender_name=EXCLUDED.sender_name,
 updated_at=NOW();`;
msg.params=[JSON.stringify(memories)];
return msg;

name: Environment / Notes
info: Required env: PGHOST=postgres; PGPORT=5432; PGDATABASE=ai_integrator; PGUSER=ai_integrator; PGPASSWORD=<password>. AI multi-provider: AI_PROVIDER_ORDER=groq,gemini,openrouter; GROQ_API_KEY=<key>; GROQ_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-20b; GEMINI_API_KEY=<key>; GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.6-flash; OPENROUTER_API_KEY=<key>; OPENROUTER_MODEL=openrouter/free. Optional: AI_MEMORY_BATCH_SIZE=8, AI_MEMORY_BATCH_MESSAGES=30, AI_MEMORY_CONTEXT_CHARS=18000, AI_CHAT_TOP_K=12, AI_MEMORY_MESSAGES=10, AI_TEMPERATURE=0.2. The flow never uses OpenCode Free inference. It tries providers in AI_PROVIDER_ORDER and falls back on HTTP/network/provider failure. This flow assumes V3 schema tables chat_users, chat_messages, ai_memories, ai_conversations, knowledge_chunks exist; it creates ai_memory_state and indexes automatically. Disable Telegram Group Privacy in BotFather if the bot must receive ordinary group messages.
